veranderings.blok: Metaal kan in dun drade getrek word
veranderings.rede: Two coordinate adjectives before a noun (lank en dun) are separated by a comma under the AWS.

veranderings.voor: Wanneer 'n vaste stof warm word en in 'n vloeistof verander.
veranderings.na: Om van 'n vaste stof in 'n vloeistof te verander wanneer dit warm word.
veranderings.rede: A verb's definition should not open with 'Wanneer' (an English 'is when' construction); the 'Om ... te' form defines the verb itself with the same meaning.
